Highly recommend and reasonable.
Aug 2026 • Family
The food is delicious, the prices are reasonable, and I highly recommend this restaurant if you want to experience unique Vietnamese cuisine. The local restaurants in Hanoi’s Old Quarter are great as well, but sometimes it’s nice to get away from the hustle and bustle and enjoy a relaxing meal here. The staff member, Stellar, was extremely kind and welcoming, and her hospitality made our experience even more enjoyable.
